tagline: End-to-end commercial biopharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing specialty biologics
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary growth driver for the company, benefiting from FDA approval in April 2025 of the innovative yield enhancement process that increases production by 20% or more from the same volume of source plasma

kpis.name: ASCENIV Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from ASCENIV, plasma-derived IVIG for treatment of Primary Immunodeficiency in adults and adolescents, with commercial sales commenced October 2019
kpis.signal: Substantial revenue growth driven by expanded prescriber and patient base

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income of the company on GAAP basis
kpis.description: Net income on GAAP basis for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, representing first profitability milestone in company history
kpis.signal: First net income achievement in company history achieved in fiscal year 2024, continued into 2025

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities
kpis.description: Positive cash flow from operations of $118.7 million for fiscal year 2024, continued throughout fiscal year 2025
kpis.signal: Positive cash flow from operations achieved and sustained

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin expected to expand in fiscal 2026 with first full year of yield-enhanced production
kpis.signal: Anticipated continued margin expansion in fiscal 2026 from yield enhancement process

kpis.name: ASCENIV Production Yield Enhancement
kpis.explanation: Production yield increase from innovative yield enhancement process
kpis.description: Innovative yield enhancement production process approved by FDA in April 2025 increases ASCENIV and BIVIGAM production yields by 20% or more from same starting source plasma volume
kpis.signal: FDA approval of Prior Approval Supplement in April 2025 enabling 20% or more yield increase

kpis.name: Plasma Collection Facilities
kpis.explanation: Number of FDA-licensed source plasma collection centers operated
kpis.description: ADMA BioCenters operates plasma collection centers, reduced from 8 to 7 following December 2025 divestiture as part of shift to capital-efficient supply model
kpis.signal: Strategic divestiture of 3 centers completed with long-term plasma supply agreements executed

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: Historically, a few customers have represented a significant portion of revenues and total accounts receivable. Loss of any major customer could have a material adverse effect on business, operating results and financial condition.

risks.title: Third-Party Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Reliance on third parties for supply of services and raw materials essential to production could result in delays or interruptions in delivery of finished products.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory inspections and FDA actions could have a negative impact on the company, particularly in case of non-compliance with regulatory requirements.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks and security breaches could compromise confidential information and damage reputation.

risks.title: Product Quality
risks.score_rationale: Product quality issues could result in recalls, fines and loss of customer confidence.

risks.title: Pandemic or Epidemic
risks.score_rationale: A pandemic or epidemic could have a negative impact on the company due to supply chain and production disruptions.

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.score_rationale: Ability to maintain profitability and generate positive cash flows is uncertain, and the company may need additional financing to support operations.

ai_positioning.summary: ADMA Biologics uses artificial intelligence in its supply chain and production operations. The company has implemented a strategy to improve the efficiency of its manufacturing capacity, enhance yields, strengthen supply chain robustness, and improve in-house fill and finish capabilities.
evidence: our use of AI in our supply chain and production operations
